issues.description: The UML/problem specification indicates the Farm.animals attribute is private (aggregation: - animals: List<Animal>) and the text asks for getter and setter, but the solution declares the field as public (public List<Animal> animals;). This visibility mismatch could confuse students about whether the field should be encapsulated and may cause automated checks that expect a private field with accessors to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Farm.animals field private to match the UML/specification (private List<Animal> animals;) and keep the provided public getter and setter. Alternatively, if public access was intended, update the problem statement/UML to indicate a public field, but the preferred fix is to encapsulate the field and rely on getter/setter to preserve the educational intent about encapsulation.
